description: Maintain statement coverage >= 90% on changed files
rationale: High coverage catches regressions before they reach production
Branches encode business logic and must be exercised

description: Test observable behavior, not implementation details
rationale: Behavior-based tests survive refactors; implementation tests don't

description: Structure tests as Arrange, Act, Assert with clear sections
rationale: AAA makes tests scannable and intent obvious

description: Name tests as 'should X when Y' describing behavior
rationale: Descriptive names turn failing test output into a bug report

description: Each test must run independently and in any order
rationale: Shared state across tests causes flaky failures

description: Mock at system boundaries (HTTP, DB, FS) — not internal modules
Reset mocks in beforeEach or afterEach to prevent leakage
rationale: Stale mocks cause confusing cross-test pollution

description: Never use sleep() or fixed timeouts — use waitFor or fake timers
rationale: Fixed sleeps cause flaky tests and slow suites

description: Never skip a test without linking a tracked issue
rationale: Untracked skips become permanent technical debt

description: Avoid snapshots of complex objects — assert specific fields instead
rationale: Large snapshots are fragile and rarely reviewed carefully

description: Cover null, empty, boundary, and error paths in addition to happy path
rationale: Edge cases are where most bugs hide

description: Follow red-green-refactor: failing test first, minimal fix, then refactor
rationale: TDD drives simpler designs and guarantees test coverage

description: Write integration tests at the API or component seam, not for every unit
rationale: Integration tests give the highest confidence per line of test code
